name: The Night is Mine

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
1 or R

You turn the darkness itself on those who hide within. The target takes 2d4 cold damage with a basic Reflex save. If a creature within range attempts to Hide, you can cast this spell targeting them as a reaction.

---
Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4.
